summary: Quản lý gói và dự án Python viết bằng Rust. Cung cấp giải pháp giải quyết phụ thuộc cực nhanh.
usecases: Fast installation of Python packages and dependencies in CI/CD pipelines
Managing virtual environments and Python versions across multiple projects
Offline dependency resolution for restricted network environments
ideas: Integrate as a backend build step in serverless Python functions for instant cold-start optimization
Use as a foundation for a multi-language project manager combining Rust and Python ecosystems
Develop a GUI dashboard for visualizing dependency trees and resolution speed comparisons
